Definition: probably a weight; used as a commercial standard
BiblicalUsage: 1) shekel; 1a) the chief unit of weight or measure; 1a1) gold-1/10000 of a talent and equal to 220 grains; 1a2) silver-1/3000 of a talent and equal to 132 grains; 1a3) copper-1/1500 of a talent and equal to 528 grains
